phase1.evidence: Independent reset-bridge contract: entry CPU BFF6 under mode3 lower pair selects this physical tail; SEI then INC FFFF writes high-bit fixed IRQ-vector byte and resets MMC1 control to mode3 while preserving selected lower pair. Three vector words BFF6 also decode as INC zp,X instructions; fallthrough wraps into fixed-bank C000 reset after exactly10bytes. RAM side effects safe under reset contract because reset clears working state. Identical bridge at seven pair tails and each encoded vector targets BFF6 support purposeful dual code/vector role. Natural entry not observed; analysis/round01/reset-bridges.json.
